name: kalshi-whale-poc-frontend
description: Build tooling for static/index.html's dashboard JS. Source lives in src/js/ as real ES modules (import/export); esbuild bundles them into static/js/dashboard.bundle.js, which is what index.html actually loads. Edits to src/js/ need a rebuild (npm run build, or npm run watch during active development) - they are not served directly.
